name: Collin Mauren
summary: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren studies practical magic and crafts useful spells from natural reagents. He also makes arcane scrolls for his friend Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome engineer and explorer.

sections.title: Scholar of the Arcane
sections.body: In Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Collin Mauren studies magic's practical uses. He crafts arcane formulas to solve specific problems, drawing on natural anomalies and raw components gathered across Azeroth. Their properties help him make functional scrolls and reagents for friends and travelers.

sections.title: Aiding Gaxim Rustfizzle
sections.body: Collin Mauren is helping his friend Gaxim Rustfizzle set off NG-5 explosives from a distance. Gaxim, a gnome tinkerer, needed a way to trigger them remotely, so Collin devised a messaging spell for a scroll. To impress the spell on it, Collin uses debris from Westfall's erratic Dust Devils. He awaits word on how Gaxim's scheme fares.

sections.title: Exotic Studies in Stonetalon
sections.body: Collin Mauren's studies reach from Stormwind across the Great Sea to Kalimdor's Stonetalon Mountains. He seeks the scales of the region's basilisks, whose resilient hides interest him as materials for synthesizing new spells. Travelers heading into Kalimdor often receive his requests for these rare hides. The scales fuel his study of how primal creature anatomy can steady complex enchantments.

faq.q: Where can Collin Mauren be found?
faq.answer: Collin Mauren can be found in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter, among the towers and shops used by the capital's arcane scholars.

faq.q: What kind of magic does Collin specialize in?
faq.answer: Collin specializes in applied enchantments and utility spells. He experiments with natural components such as elemental debris and beast scales to craft scrolls, including a messaging spell for Gaxim's remote explosives, as well as other unique dweomers.

faq.q: Who is Gaxim Rustfizzle and how is Collin connected to him?
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle is an adventurous gnome tinkerer and Collin's friend. When Gaxim needed to detonate his explosives from afar, Collin made him a scroll bearing a messaging spell.

faq.q: Why does Collin need elemental debris from Westfall?
faq.answer: Collin needs debris from one of Westfall's Dust Devils to impress a messaging spell onto a scroll. Gaxim Rustfizzle needs the spell to set off his NG-5 explosives from a distance.

faq.q: Why is Collin interested in the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: Collin studies basilisk scales from the Stonetalon Mountains in Kalimdor for their magical properties. He uses their sturdy, naturally resistant hides as bases for synthesizing new incantations.

faq.q: Is Collin aligned with the Kirin Tor?
faq.answer: Collin lives in the Mage Quarter and practices traditions common among Alliance wizards. He works chiefly as an independent researcher and reagent crafter, rather than as an active Dalaran representative.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can see Collin's experimental approach to spellcraft: he uses reagents such as elemental debris and basilisk scales to weave utility magic.
As a human, you share a city with Collin, whose quiet studies in Stormwind's Mage Quarter reflect the scholarly pursuits of human wizards.
As an Alliance member, you can see how Collin supplies adventurers with utility magic for communication and trade across the faction, from Westfall to Kalimdor.
